description: Implementation of IQ compression and decompression functions for fixed-point representation, including quantization, packing, and unpacking of IQ samples in resource blocks.

classes.name: iq_compression_bfp_impl
classes.description: Implementation class for IQ fixed-point compression and decompression algorithms.

methods.name: quantize_input
methods.description: Converts input brain float samples to fixed-point int16_t representation and computes RMS for debugging.

methods.name: compress_prb_generic
methods.description: Compresses a resource block of quantized samples into a bit-packed format with exponent scaling.

methods.name: compress
methods.description: Performs full compression pipeline: quantizes float IQ data, then compresses into resource blocks.

methods.name: decompress_prb_generic
methods.description: Decompresses a resource block from bit-packed format back to IQ samples with scaling.

methods.name: decompress
methods.description: Performs full decompression pipeline: unpacks resource blocks into IQ float samples.
